# Eire Tech

> Eire Tech is a full-service digital solutions company helping businesses grow, automate, and innovate — digital marketing, business automation, brand management, web and app development, custom AI, graphic design, and video, delivered by one connected team.

Eire Tech covers nine disciplines under one roof, so clients do not need to coordinate multiple agencies, tools, and freelancers. Work is automation-first and measured against business outcomes rather than one-off deliverables. Serving start-ups and scaling businesses alike.

Contact: info@eiretech360.com | +353 89 942 7009
Office: 1717 N Street NW, Ste 1, Washington, DC 20036, US

- [Platforms & Tools](https://eiretech360.com/platforms): Technologies used across web and e-commerce, CRM and automation, design, marketing, app development, and AI.
- [Contact](https://eiretech360.com/contact/): Enquiry form and direct contact details for starting a project.
